en: A monochrome postcard view of a formal park with manicured flowerbeds, cone-shaped topiary bushes, benches, and a few strolling figures in early-20th‑century clothing. In the background stands a multi‑storey historic spa or hotel building partially obscured by trees. At the top of the postcard are printed captions identifying the location as Bad Elster and the Kurhausanlagen (spa gardens).
